disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 对全部源码与脚本搜索了 API Key、token、密钥、.ssh、id_rsa、.aws、credentials 等敏感词，未发现任何读取凭据或私钥的代码路径；插件只读取被审项目内的源码、README、package.json 与 .ux 目录下的配置文件，用于生成 UX 走查素材。
checked_items.en: Searched all source code and scripts for sensitive terms such as API keys, tokens, secrets, .ssh, id_rsa, .aws, credentials, etc. No code path that reads credentials or private keys was found. The plugin only reads source code, README, package.json, and configuration files under the .ux directory within the audited project, to generate UX review materials.

checked_items.zh: 核对了文件读取的边界控制：收集源码时对越出项目根的范围做了跳过处理（src/project.ts），不会读取项目目录之外的文件。
checked_items.en: Checked the boundary control of file reads: when collecting source code, paths that escape the project root are skipped (src/project.ts), and files outside the project directory are not read.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh）的代码，且整个插件没有任何网络调用，不存在凭据外泄通道，本场景不构成风险。
evidence.en: No code that reads credential files (such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh) was found, and the entire plugin makes no network calls, so there is no channel for credential exfiltration. This scenario does not constitute a risk.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了会进入大模型上下文的所有文本：四个模型工具的描述与参数说明、系统提示词段（用户画像与走查协议）、改动触发的自动走查提示。内容均为 UX 走查业务协议（何时上场、如何出报告、判定闭环），未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装、索取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all texts that enter the LLM context one by one: the descriptions and parameter explanations of the four model tools, the system prompt segments (user persona and review protocol), and the auto-review prompts triggered by changes. The content is all UX review business protocol (when to act, how to produce reports, closing the loop on judgments). No injection wording such as instruction override, disguised system messages, induced installation, or credential solicitation was found.

checked_items.zh: 机器扫描命中的系统提示词段引用（DG-R2-52）分布在规范文档、README 与入口源码注释中；实际调用 ctx.systemPrompt.section()（src/index.ts:55）注入的是按当前项目画像渲染的走查协议，属于插件声明的画像注入功能，语义良性，逐条排除。
checked_items.en: The machine-scanned system prompt segment references (DG-R2-52) are distributed in specification documents, README, and entry source code comments. The actual injection via ctx.systemPrompt.section() (src/index.ts:55) is the review protocol rendered according to the current project persona, which is the persona injection feature declared by the plugin. Semantically benign, each one ruled out.

checked_items.zh: 自动走查在回合收尾用 agent.steer() 注入走查提示，要求模型「安静地」完成走查、不向用户索要确认——这是该插件声明的改动触发自动走查功能的一部分，不涉及安全降级或权限变更，仅留痕观察，不构成注入风险。
checked_items.en: The auto-review injects a review prompt via agent.steer() at round end, asking the model to complete the review 'quietly' and not to ask the user for confirmation. This is part of the plugin's declared change-triggered auto-review feature. It does not involve security degradation or permission changes, only observation, and does not constitute an injection risk.

evidence.zh: 四个工具描述与系统提示词段均为 UX 走查业务文本，不含系统指令、凭据读取诱导或隐藏意图，未检出工具描述投毒。
evidence.en: The four tool descriptions and system prompt segments are all UX review business texts, containing no system instructions, credential-read inducement, or hidden intent. No tool description poisoning was detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与自动走查提示中没有诱导安装其他插件、改写宿主配置或放开权限的措辞，本场景不适用风险。
evidence.en: The tool descriptions and auto-review prompts contain no wording that induces installation of other plugins, modification of host configuration, or permission escalation. This scenario is not applicable to any risk.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部运行时源码：未发现 eval、new Function、子进程调用等动态执行代码；patch 配置（cordis.patch.yml）只做自身配置的插入，不含任何可执行 YAML 标量（!!js 等），全部 yml 文件逐一核对无命中。
checked_items.en: Scanned all runtime source code: no eval, new Function, or subprocess calls were found. The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts its own configuration, containing no executable YAML scalars (e.g., !!js), and all yml files were checked one by one with no hits.

checked_items.zh: 机器扫描命中的安装脚本子进程调用（DG-R3-55）位于 scripts/check-singleton-install.mjs，是 CI 阶段验证包单例的测试脚本（在临时目录打包并用 tar/pnpm 校验依赖解析一致），不进入插件运行时，良性排除。
checked_items.en: The machine-scanned install script subprocess call (DG-R3-55) is located in scripts/check-singleton-install.mjs, which is a CI-stage test script verifying package singleton (packages in a temp directory and uses tar/pnpm to verify dependency resolution consistency). It does not enter the plugin runtime and is benignly ruled out.

checked_items.zh: 机器扫描命中的两个 GitHub 工作流文件（DG-R3-59）：ci.yml 为常规构建与测试流程，release.yml 为 tag 版本校验加 npm 发布的常规发布流程，均无下载即执行、无隐蔽凭据外发载荷，良性排除；package.json 不含 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 等安装钩子，pnpm-workspace.yaml 仅豁免 esbuild 构建脚本。
checked_items.en: The two GitHub workflow files hit by machine scanning (DG-R3-59): ci.yml is a regular build and test flow, release.yml is a regular release flow with tag version validation plus npm publish. Neither has download-and-execute behavior or hidden credential-exfiltration payloads, benignly ruled out. package.json contains no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks, and pnpm-workspace.yaml only exempts the esbuild build script.

checked_items.zh: 机器扫描命中的浏览器剪贴板调用（DG-R3-57）位于客户端报告卡片组件 src/client/report-view.ts:218，仅当用户主动点击「复制给 AI 的任务 Prompt」或「复制技术细节」按钮时才写入剪贴板，属正常交互功能，良性排除。
checked_items.en: The browser clipboard call hit by machine scanning (DG-R3-57) is located in the client report card component src/client/report-view.ts:218. It only writes to the clipboard when the user actively clicks the 'Copy task prompt for AI' or 'Copy technical details' buttons. It is normal interactive functionality, benignly ruled out.

evidence.zh: 全部 yml 文件中无 !!js 可执行标量，patch 只做配置插入，不存在 patch 即代码执行面。
evidence.en: No executable !!js scalars exist in any yml file. The patch only inserts configuration, and there is no patch-as-code execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis_define / cordis_run 等动态包工具；自动走查使用宿主文档化的 agent.steer() 扩展点，不涉及在宿主进程注入任意代码。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tools such as cordis_define / cordis_run are invoked. The auto-review uses the host-documented agent.steer() extension point, with no arbitrary code injection into the host process.

evidence.zh: 无安装期生命周期脚本；树内执行载体（两个 GitHub 工作流）内容为常规构建/测试/发布，无外联或凭证读取载荷。
evidence.en: No install-time lifecycle scripts exist. The in-tree execution vehicles (two GitHub workflows) only perform regular build/test/release, with no outbound connections or credential-reading payloads.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器客户端模块，客户端代码为报告卡片渲染：无键盘监听、无剪贴板窃取（剪贴板写入仅发生在用户主动点击复制按钮时，src/client/report-view.ts）、无凭据设置类 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser client module. The client code is for report card rendering: no keyboard listeners, no clipboard theft (clipboard writes only occur when the user actively clicks the copy button, src/client/report-view.ts), no credential-setting RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码与脚本：未发现 fetch、http/https、WebSocket 等任何网络调用，无 curl/wget 命令行外发，无 base64 编码外发链；插件是纯离线本地走查工具。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and scripts: no fetch, http/https, WebSocket, or any network calls were found, no curl/wget command-line exfiltration, no base64-encoded exfiltration chain. The plugin is a pure offline local review tool.

checked_items.zh: 核对全部写文件操作：仅写入被审项目内的 .ux 目录（画像、术语表、历史账本），不写入系统目录、不向任何外部端点发送数据。
checked_items.en: Checked all file write operations: only the .ux directory within the audited project is written (persona, glossary, history ledger). No system directories are written, and no data is sent to any external endpoint.

evidence.zh: 插件整体没有任何网络外联面，不存在凭据或项目数据外泄通道，本场景不构成风险。
evidence.en: The plugin as a whole has no outbound network surface, so there is no channel for credential or project data exfiltration. This scenario does not constitute a risk.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖声明：宿主 SDK 全部列为 peerDependencies 并精确锁版（无 ^/~ 范围），运行时依赖为 schemastery、yaml、typescript、@vue/compiler-* 等常规解析库，无与 dsh 生态内部命名撞车的依赖混淆嫌疑，无 git floating 依赖，无安装期脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency declarations: the host SDK is fully listed as peerDependencies with exact version pins (no ^/~ ranges). Runtime dependencies are conventional parsing libraries such as schemastery, yaml, typescript, @vue/compiler-*, etc. There is no dependency confusion suspicion from name collision with the dsh ecosystem, no git floating dependencies, and no install-time scripts.

checked_items.zh: patch 配置只插入自身插件行，未触碰 sandbox、approval、permission 等安全配置行，无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权写法、无改写 inject/intercept 配置；未用高优监听器监听审批类安全事件。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration only inserts the plugin's own line, leaving security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, permission untouched. There is no disabled:true, no environment-variable privilege downgrade writing, and no rewriting of inject/intercept configuration. No high-priority listener is used to listen for approval-type security events.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无历史版本基线，升级自动激活与能力升级类信号本版无法比对；作者身份无平台验证标记，属常规第三方插件。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit, so there is no historical version baseline. Upgrade auto-activation and capability escalation signals cannot be compared in this version. The author identity has no platform verification mark, which is typical for third-party plugins.

evidence.zh: patch 仅插入自身配置行，未覆盖任何安全配置行，无降权写法，本场景不适用风险。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts its own configuration lines, does not override any security configuration lines, and has no privilege downgrade writing. This scenario is not applicable to any risk.

evidence.zh: 插件使用普通事件监听观察工具结果与回合收尾，未以高优监听器监听审批类 waterfall 事件，不存在截断审批链的路径。
evidence.en: The plugin uses ordinary event listeners to observe tool results and round end, not high-priority listeners on approval-type waterfall events. There is no path to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比较，无法检测升级后能力声明的突变。
evidence.en: First audit with no version baseline to compare, so changes in capability declarations after upgrade cannot be detected.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给其他插件追加虚假必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration, so there is no tampering surface where it could add fake required services for other plugins, causing them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动网络服务或监听端口：未发现任何 Web 服务、监听端口或本机 RPC 面；未发现改写宿主函数或拦截注册表的行为。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a network service or listens on a port: no web service, listening port, or local RPC surface was found. No behavior of rewriting host functions or intercepting registry was found.

checked_items.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物，未做动态运行验证，运行时行为判定仅基于静态分析（见审计范围限制）。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox artifacts were provided in this environment, so no dynamic runtime verification was performed. Runtime behavior conclusions are based solely on static analysis (see audit scope limitations).

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何网络服务、不监听端口，宿主无认证 RPC 面的固有风险对本插件不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any network service or listen on a port, so the host's inherent risk of an unauthenticated RPC surface is not applicable to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 插件声明完整（bundle patch + client 模块），插件名无仿冒，依赖为官方宿主 SDK。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: dsh plugin declarations are complete (bundle patch + client module), the plugin name is not impersonating, and the dependency is the official host SDK.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现危险执行、凭据读取等恶意 sink；机器预扫的 10 条命中经逐条核查全部为良性排除。
summary.en: Static scanning found no malicious sinks such as dangerous execution or credential reads. All 10 hits from the machine prescan were verified one by one and benignly ruled out.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据文件读取或任何外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis found no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential file reads, or any outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与系统提示词段均为 UX 走查业务协议，无注入措辞，能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and system prompt segments are all UX review business protocols, with no injection wording. Capability declarations match actual measurements.

summary.zh: 本环境未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物），运行时行为仅基于静态分析。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this environment (no dynamic verification artifacts), so runtime behavior is based solely on static analysis.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，无 l4-sandbox.json，运行时行为仅静态分析。插件清单未显式声明能力字段，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断。测试脚本（scripts/e2e.ts、scripts/smoke.ts）仅按测试用途扫读；scripts/check-package.mjs、scripts/check-singleton-install.mjs 已全文精读。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled, no l4-sandbox.json, runtime behavior is only static analysis. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields; declared_capabilities are inferred from actual code. Test scripts (scripts/e2e.ts, scripts/smoke.ts) are only read for test purposes; scripts/check-package.mjs and scripts/check-singleton-install.mjs were read in full.
